# Complexity_Emergence

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-07-30

## Definition
The property of a system that spontaneously generates order while maintaining flexibility and adaptability, balancing rigidity and variability. This concept is foundational for designing neuromorphic in-network systems that must self-organize and adapt to dynamic data flows without external reprogramming.
